# Psalm 30 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm. A-song [for] the-dedication of-the-house. Of-David.

**2** I-will-exalt-You, YHWH, for You-have-drawn-me-up, and-You-have-not let-my-enemies rejoice over-me.

**3** YHWH my-God, I-cried-for-help to-You, and-You-healed-me.

**4** YHWH, You-brought-up my-soul from-Sheol; You-kept-me-alive from-[among those] going-down [to] the-pit.

**5** Sing-praise to-YHWH, O-His-faithful-ones, and-give-thanks to-the-remembrance of-His-holiness.

**6** For a-moment [is] in-His-anger, a-lifetime in-His-favor. In-the-evening weeping comes-to-lodge, but-in-the-morning — a-shout-of-joy.

**7** And-I said in-my-prosperity, 'I-shall-never be-moved.'

**8** YHWH, in-Your-favor You-made-stand for-my-mountain strength; You-hid Your-face — I-was dismayed.

**9** To-You, YHWH, I-called, and-to the-Lord I-pleaded-for-mercy:

**10** 'What profit [is there] in-my-blood, in-my-going-down to-the-pit? Shall-the-dust praise-You? Shall-it declare Your-faithfulness?

**11** Hear, YHWH, and-be-gracious to-me; YHWH, be my-helper!'

**12** You-have-turned my-mourning into-dancing; You-have-loosened my-sackcloth and-clothed-me [with] gladness,

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **30:6**: One of the most quoted verses in the Psalter. The Hebrew rhythm is stunning: rega be-apo / chayyim birtsono — a moment in His anger / a lifetime in His favor.

— EMET
